reviews.text: I was treated good and they were very professional

I took my dog to the PetSmart Groomers for the first time and they completely shaved every hair off her body. She is a poodle mix, so her hair is fluffy, but should not be shaved down to a one. Mercedes unfortunately seemed more concerned with getting it done quickly rather than doing a good job. When I arrived, she was grooming, a golden doodle, and the dog looked flawless, beautiful. So when they went to get pumpkin, I had high hopes that she would look as good as the golden doodle. Unfortunately, that was not the case, and I will not be returning.

If you do take your dog to this Groomer, make sure you are extremely clear with your expectations.
Super friendly. And the people who take care of the dogs there are the best. I’ve tried other PetSmarts, but this location is the best! I wouldn't go anywhere else!

I take my Aussie here for grooming and Mercedes is so good with him! He’s very anxious and she always takes the time to make him feel safe and provides the most exceptional and caring service. They really do prioritize animal care and safety. I appreciate the detailed and timely communication I receive.
The service is excellent. I highly recommend the people who bathe the dogs.

I have been taking my pup here for years!!! Chris usually takes care of him when he goes in, however he was not there. First, I get a call saying I can bring him in earlier because they had multiple cancelations. His appointment was at 12:30, I took him at 12. It's 4:15 and I get a call saying it's gonna take my pup longer to be done because they have cats in right now and they don't cut both animals during the same time. On top of that, she made a rude comment about him being difficult.  Granted, my pup gets a little anxious with all the noise and everything going on in the groomers salon. I found her comment to be quite off putting. They called me and said he can come in early. Now you're telling me it's going to be beyond the normal 3 to 4 hours.  That is unacceptable especially because it seems as if the cats were just dropped off today because they have availability but my appointment was made days ago. I am very disappointed in the comment she made and the lack of consideration for my time.

Lou love's it here his almost 4 months and they have done such a great job with him . I love the  communication the staff has with their clients. Yadira is Lou's person she is awesome. Prices are fair and reasonable most people won't ask but 45$/50$  plus tip one time a month is not bad . Try them out
